confirm.title: Disconnect Studio Mac?
confirm.body: Disconnecting revokes this computer's Campus access, fails its queued runs, marks live runs lost, and unbinds its Offices. Cards those Offices hold move to Blocked for a person to review, and Campus restarts nothing automatically. Campus cannot confirm that local processes have stopped. Its project folder links stay on Campus and return if this computer registers again; its Offices stay unbound. This computer may reconnect or claim work after this status was displayed; disconnect applies to that work too.
